title: derivePoolBarrierSeriesInput
description: The request derive-pool-barrier-series.mjs reads via --request or stdin: the base floor and every member's declared rent/utility/heating obligation the barrier rises ahead of.

baseFloor.description: Exact HBD decimal string: the barrier with no obligations pending.

leadDays.description: Forward-looking window in which a due obligation counts toward the barrier; defaults to 14.
